title: Experience
content: A seasoned career across logistics, insurtech, agritech, fintech, and developer platforms. Fullstack associate manager at Alto Network (2026 — now): leading 11 engineers on Scrum, enforcing SDLC best practices, building internal platforms for Indonesia's payment switching infrastructure — 99.99% SLA, 27M records/day. Senior software engineer at AIA Indonesia (2024 — 26): hardened reliability on AKS, refactored legacy codebases, cut agent recruitment page load from 48 seconds to 1 second. Software engineer, platform at eFishery (2021 — 24): built developer tools, OneFish DLS, a unified login system, and a JS auth SDK; introduced Nix flakes for faster onboarding. Full-stack engineer at Jubelio (2020 — 21): integrated marketplaces, couriers, and payment gateways; built an integration factory on Azure Functions. React Native developer at SiCepat Express (2019 — 20): shipped SiCepat App, SiGesit, and SiCepat Absensi. Assistant tech mentor at Impact Byte (2019). Toolbox: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node, Go, Python, PostgreSQL, SQL, NoSQL, React Native, Flutter, Kubernetes, Azure, GraphQL.

title: Projects
content: Payment switching internal platform (Alto Network, 2026): internal platform for Indonesia's payment switching infrastructure — one of the country's four licensed switching companies — with high-volume data viewing and download, 27 million records per day, straight from core systems. Tech: Java Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL. OneFish DLS (eFishery, 2024): platform tool that streamlined core processes and eliminated key development pain points for faster feature delivery across teams. Tech: developer tools, internal platform. Unified login system (eFishery, 2023): architecture and JS SDK for authentication services across multiple platforms, cutting feature delivery timelines and standardizing security protocols. Tech: auth, JavaScript SDK, security. Integration factory (Jubelio, 2021): factory pattern for third-party integrations — marketplaces, couriers, payment gateways — that cut integration development time significantly. Tech: integrations, Azure Functions. More experiments on GitHub at github.com/arifinoid.
